desc: owner is interpolated into the SQL string: owner = "x' OR '1'='1" lists every user's files
pages start at 1 but the offset uses page * PAGE_SIZE, so page 1 skips the first 20 files and the last page is always empty
name from the URL is joined unchecked: ../../etc/passwd (or an absolute path) escapes the owner's directory
an unknown file_id makes fetchone() return None, so row["owner"] raises TypeError (a 500) instead of a not-found error
the UPDATE and DELETE are never committed: the file is removed from disk but the row and quota change roll back, leaving a dangling row
